name: context-optimizer
description: Keeps the context lean automatically: trims noise, picks the right moment to compact and shows the tokens it saved.

trimAboveChars.title: Trim tool results longer than (characters)
trimAboveChars.description: A tool result longer than this is cut to its head, its tail and the lines that mention errors before Claude reads it. 0 turns trimming off.

trimTools.title: Tools whose results are trimmed
trimTools.description: Comma-separated tool names; mcp__* stands for every MCP tool. Read and Edit are never trimmed. Bash is left to output-trimmer when it is installed.

suggestAt.title: Suggest compacting from (% full)
suggestAt.description: From this context fill on, a task boundary (a commit, green tests, a cleared todo list, a new topic) is reported as a good moment to /compact.

autoCompact.title: Compact automatically
autoCompact.description: At a good moment, run /compact with a focus by itself once the session has been idle for idleSeconds. Off: it only suggests.

idleSeconds.title: Idle before auto-compact (seconds)
idleSeconds.description: How long nothing may happen after a turn before autoCompact runs /compact.

carryOver.title: Carry-over across /compact
carryOver.description: Before a compaction, keep a short note of decisions, open todos and files in play, and give it back to Claude with the next prompt.

dedupeReads.title: Dedupe repeated reads
dedupeReads.description: When Claude reads the same unchanged file range again before any compaction, replace the copy with a one-line note pointing at the earlier read.
